value.value: Early noncrystalline absorption is attributed to basic zinc-acetate clusters. Zn4O(OAc)6 and Zn10O4(OAc)12 are cited ethanol structures; analogous DMSO precursors are proposed, not directly identified in this study.

value.value: Critical surviving nuclei exclude dopants; subsequent surface binding and OH− reaction incorporate Co nearly isotropically during growth. This is inferred from spectral titration, not an atom-by-atom dopant map.

value.value: Pseudo-octahedral dopants in basic acetate precursors must convert to tetrahedral ZnO coordination, adding a nucleation barrier. The authors also emphasize reduced thermodynamic driving force from impurity strain.

value.value: Surface/near-surface dopants increase strain and specific surface energy, increasing solubility and the critical nucleation radius and lowering metastable final dimensions. No numerical σ, solubility, critical radius or activation energy is fitted.

value.value: A broad intermediate is assigned to inhomogeneous tetrahedral Co bound at ZnO surfaces, as monomers or basic-acetate fragments, before incorporation by hydroxide. Comparison to excess-acetate Co in DMSO supports stronger acetate than lattice-oxide ligand fields.

value.value: Band-gap intensity versus added base extrapolates nearly through the origin after nucleation, suggesting most added hydroxide forms ZnO rather than persistent molecular precursors. Internal-Co intensity instead intercepts near 0.36 equivalent, supporting initial core exclusion.

quality.review_scope: All14 main and4 matched SI pages text-read and visually inspected with independent source, canonical, molecular, reader and apparatus audits. Separate pure/doped routes, postprocessing, surface-bound control, magnetic aggregates and theoretical models retain distinct sample scopes. Missing parameters and source conflicts remain explicit; cited external works not independently inspected.
missing_fields: Per-specimen synthesis batches and complete links between nominal feed doping and measured incorporation are not given.
Several workup volumes, separation hardware, stirring speed, aging times, TOPO/powder ratio and exact purification cycles are unreported.
No measured atomic coordinate file, sample-specific refined dopant occupancy, raw spectral array or full statistical error model is supplied.
